Title: 3 Cushion Billiards
WarmUpHint: Press Space or T (or 3 / Page Down) to pause/resume, R (or 6 / Right Arrow) to reset, Enter to restart, C or Esc (or 9 / Page Up) to return to the board.
ControlsHint: Press C (or 9 / Page Up) to hide, T (or 3 / Page Down) to start/stop the shot clock, R (or 6 / Right Arrow) to reset it. Press 1/2 to switch the active player, +/- to adjust the current points, Enter to commit them. Press W (or 5) to start the warm-up timer, P (or 0 / Insert) to open the player picker, Backspace to close it. Press Del (numpad .) to end the match, N (or 8) for a new game, * for handicap, / to enter the match target.
NoPlayersInRoster: No players in the roster yet - add some on the Players page.
BoardOccupiedElsewhere: This board is already open in another window.
PlayerAlreadySelected: This player is already selected on the other side.
MatchTargetReachedText: {0} reached {1} points. Extend the match or end it?
ShortcutNumberHint: Type a shortcut number, Enter to choose, arrows to move
PickerNavHint: Up/Down or + / - to move, Enter to choose, Del to close
NoPlayerWithShortcut: No player with that shortcut number.
TargetEntryHint: Type the digits, Enter confirms, . deletes / closes.
